ctx.x: Okay. Fletcher Henderson. We all went down to the Chicago Armory. I can name every member of that band right now.

His reed section was Buster Bailey on alto sax and clarinet. He had Jerome Pascual playing alto sax and clarinet. Coleman Hawkins played the tenor saxophone. Trumpet -- he had Russell Smith playing first trumpet. Joe Smith was playing second trumpet, and a fellow named Tommy Ladnier playing third trumpet and he was the get off man.
